text: one more thing i place a prop and i cant rotate it after. i can rotate it before. its annoying asf
resolution: Made placed props immediately rotatable after placement in the iso3d editor. Single piece placement now parks the placed pose in the existing reselect-by-signature path before committing piecePlaced, so once the stream mints the id the landed prop becomes selected. Because selected objects win the R key over the still-armed ghost, you can place a prop and press R to rotate the placed prop instead of only rotating the next ghost.
